the_ruling_verbatim: RULED: the boat is owned by the ticket... or is the ticket depending on point of view. and the intentions always own their tickets.
lemme clarify. the harbormaster owns the harbor. he reports on the state of it. the gate is the refuser but it's doing so on behalf of the ticket. so the ticket owns the refusal.
now_the_spec_says: A boat IS its ticket, and intentions own tickets. The harbormaster owns the harbor and REPORTS on it; it owns neither the boats nor the authority. The gate refuses on the TICKET's behalf, so the ticket owns the refusal. A peer system — no device sits above a boat.
